FROM errand_order eo LEFT JOIN `user` cu ON eo.user_id = cu.id LEFT JOIN `user` ru ON eo.runner_id = ru.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` ( username, password, phone, role, email, verified, points, starter_points_granted, invite_code, runner_application_status, runner_application_reviewed_at, banned, cancellation_count, runner_give_up_count ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{email}, 1, #{points}, 1, #{inviteCode}, #{runnerApplicationStatus}, #{runnerApplicationReviewedAt}, 0, 0, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET username = #{username}, phone = #{phone}, role = #{role}, points = #{points}, verified = #{verified}, runner_application_status = #{runnerApplicationStatus}, runner_application_reviewed_at = #{runnerApplicationReviewedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO errand_order ( user_id, runner_id, order_no, order_type, order_type_label, pickup_method, pickup_location, pickup_notes, delivery_location, delivery_method, delivery_pin, delivery_proof_status, photo_proof_url, photo_proof_note, time_window_type, time_window_label, preferred_latest_time, base_fee, distance_fee, urgency_fee, tip_fee, weekly_card_discount_fee, total_fee, points_cost, status, status_label, cancel_reason, cancelled_at, customer_confirmed_at, points_transferred_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{runnerId}, #{orderNo}, #{orderType}, #{orderTypeLabel}, 'MANUAL_ENTRY', #{pickupLocation}, #{pickupNotes}, #{deliveryLocation}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{deliveryPin}, #{deliveryProofStatus}, NULL, NULL, 'ADMIN_SET', #{timeWindowLabel}, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{totalFee}, #{pointsCost}, #{status}, #{statusLabel}, NULL, NULL, #{customerConfirmedAt}, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE errand_order SET user_id = #{userId}, runner_id = #{runnerId}, order_type = #{orderType}, order_type_label = #{orderTypeLabel}, pickup_location = #{pickupLocation}, pickup_notes = #{pickupNotes}, delivery_location = #{deliveryLocation}, delivery_method = #{deliveryMethod}, delivery_proof_status = #{deliveryProofStatus}, time_window_label = #{timeWindowLabel}, total_fee = #{totalFee}, points_cost = #{pointsCost}, status = #{status}, status_label = #{statusLabel}, customer_confirmed_at = #{customerConfirmedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE eo.status = 'DELIVERED' OR eo.runner_review_score IS NOT NULL OR eo.review_comment IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(eo.reviewed_at, eo.updated_at) DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `user`) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `user` WHERE UPPER(role) = 'RUNNER') AS runnerUsers, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `user` WHERE UPPER(role) = 'ADMIN') AS adminUsers, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM errand_order) AS totalOrders, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM errand_order WHERE status IN ('PLACED', 'ACCEPTED', 'PICKED_UP', 'AWAITING_CUSTOMER_CONFIRMATION')) AS activeOrders, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM errand_order WHERE status = 'DELIVERED') AS completedOrders, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM errand_order WHERE status LIKE 'CANCELLED%') AS cancelledOrders, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `user` WHERE banned = 1) AS bannedUsers, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM errand_order WHERE appeal_status = 'OPEN') AS openAppeals, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points_cost), 0) FROM errand_order) AS totalPointsSpent
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET role = #{role}, points = #{points}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE `user` SET role = 'RUNNER', runner_application_status = 'APPROVED', runner_application_reviewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId} AND runner_application_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE `user` SET runner_application_status = 'REJECTED', runner_application_reviewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId} AND runner_application_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE errand_order SET status = 'CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN', status_label = 'Cancelled by Admin', runner_id = NULL, cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancelled_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status NOT IN ('DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER', 'CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN')
UPDATE errand_order SET appeal_status = 'RESOLVED', appeal_resolution = #{resolution}, appeal_resolved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND appeal_status = 'OPEN'
